name: Tecktonik Dance AI
blurb: One photo in: you on the courtyard planter doing the jerky 2000s electro arm dance.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep the person exactly as photographed: same face, hair, skin tone, body shape and outfit. They stand on top of a raised planter of leafy plants above a packed night courtyard party: brick walls washed in red party light, warm string lights overhead, DJ decks right in front, the crowd below cheering with their phones up, filming. They do the Tecktonik electro dance from the 2000s French clubs: sharp, jerky, robotic arm moves, forearms snapping across the face, hands flicking up over the head and out to the sides, wrists rolling, arms windmilling, with quick little footwork on the spot and a focused, deadpan face. Filmed on a phone from inside the crowd, looking slightly up at them, full body in frame, one continuous take, vertical 9:16. Retro 2000s electro house beat in the audio, no vocals. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
